ops.title: File upstream synckit issue: typed syncservice.Client.Call escape hatch
ops.description: Plan amendment 9 (2026-07-07): cc-pool's credpull holds the Transport and calls Do directly because syncservice.Client has no typed Call for custom methods (ccp.fetch_credential). Works fine; file the upstream issue on yasyf/synckit so consumers get a first-class hatch, then migrate credpull when it lands.
